entry_item.definition: v. t. a) To do, act, perform; a ''quasi-verbalizer' added nouns or adverbs (cf. ge-) . b) To make, produce, manufacture, fashion, construct, build. c) To put or place into; to pour into. d) To use as; to treat as.

example.definition: To fulfill, perform, execute, carry out.
To do office work; to serve as an official.
To raise or submit a complaint.
To carry on an instructive conversation, give information.
-To convene a meeting, call a conference.
To pour water in a vessel.

entry_item.definition: To make. To do, to act. To pour into. To place into.
